title: Ball Slaps and Pretzel
description: A stationary ball-handling warm-up — slapping the ball around the body, waist, legs and in a figure-eight — to wake up the hands before full-speed dribbling.

content.objective: Get the fingertips and wrists active with simple continuous ball contact.
content.setup: Each player has a ball and enough personal space to swing their arms freely.
instructions: Slap the ball quickly around the waist for 15 seconds in each direction.
Lower it and slap it around each ankle for 15 seconds in each direction.
Figure-eight the ball through the legs for 20 seconds.
Finish with 15 seconds of rapid tips off the fingers above the head.
coachingPoints: Use fingertips and pads, not the palm.
Keep the head up once the pattern feels comfortable.
Build speed gradually across the set.
commonMistakes: Slapping flat-handed instead of with the fingers.
Looking down at the ball the whole time.
Rushing through the movements instead of using the full range of motion.
content.safety: Give each player enough room so swinging arms don't collide.
